meta.title: S-Eidos
meta.description: Evidence-backed front-end pattern review. Adds a S-Eidos entry to the left sidebar that opens a workbench over the bundled rule catalog: each rule shows its classification, severity, confidence, support constraint, false-positive warning, migration example and the cited source with the date it was retrieved and the date it must be reviewed. Also registers the s_eidos_audit tool and the s-eidos-audit skill, which review explicitly named paths and write nothing. Runs entirely locally: no network calls, no telemetry, and no change to your files.

title: Front-end pattern evidence
subtitle: Every rule below is a claim with a source, a retrieval date and a review date. Age alone is never a defect.
searchPlaceholder: Filter by rule id, title or impact
limitation: This panel is a static reader of the bundled catalog. It does not scan your workspace, does not reach the network and does not write anything. To review code, ask the agent to call s_eidos_audit with explicit paths, or run the CLI.
